annotations.annotation_text: Page 54 opens Book 1, Chapter 3 ("The Trial of HCE") during the Age of Gods phase. This passage continues the public trial and persecution of HCE, the ballad of Hosty, and the testimony of witnesses, featuring HCE, the Twelve Jurors, Hosty. The nocturnal dream-narrative layers Dublin topography, world mythology, and linguistic alchemy into polysemic prose.
